feature: Standardize Haptic Feedback for Touch Interactions
description: Extend haptic feedback to all primary button interactions throughout the app. Create a centralized haptic utility hook and systematically add haptic feedback to screens and components with touch interactions. Currently only 9 source files use Haptics, leaving 70+ files with touch interactions without tactile confirmation.

phases.title: Core Infrastructure
phases.description: Create centralized haptic feedback utility hook for consistent usage across the app

subtasks.title: Create useHaptics hook
subtasks.description: Create a centralized custom hook (src/hooks/useHaptics.ts) that provides standardized haptic feedback methods: triggerLight() for simple taps/selections, triggerMedium() for important actions, triggerHeavy() for critical actions, triggerSuccess() for successful operations, triggerWarning() for warnings, and triggerError() for errors. Include error handling and platform checks.
subtasks.notes: Created src/hooks/useHaptics.ts with all required methods: triggerLight(), triggerMedium(), triggerHeavy(), triggerSuccess(), triggerWarning(), triggerError(). Includes platform checks, error handling, memoized hook methods, and standalone exported functions for flexibility. Committed as 26fc042b.

subtasks.title: Create haptics constants
subtasks.description: Define constants for haptic feedback patterns in the useHaptics hook file, documenting when each type should be used for consistency.
subtasks.notes: Added HAPTIC_PATTERNS constant object with comprehensive mapping of UI interaction types to haptic feedback. Includes 4 categories: Navigation & Selection (light), Important Actions (medium), Critical/Destructive Actions (heavy), and Feedback Notifications (success/warning/error). Also added HapticPatternType type and getHapticTrigger helper function. Committed as 0de510c7.

subtasks.notes: Added haptic feedback to SettingsScreen.tsx. Uses triggerLight() for navigation items (SettingItem presses, Sidebar category selection, external link buttons) and triggerMedium() for toggle switches (CustomSwitch, Show Trailers, Enable Downloads). Committed as 9938474c.

subtasks.title: Add haptics to ThemeScreen

subtasks.notes: Added haptic feedback to ThemeScreen.tsx. Uses triggerLight() for filter tabs, edit buttons, back/cancel buttons, and color selector buttons (previews). Uses triggerMedium() for theme selection (activation), save button, create theme button, and toggle switch. Uses triggerHeavy() for delete button (destructive action). Committed as f6a86f14.

subtasks.title: Add haptics to PlayerSettingsScreen

subtasks.notes: Added haptic feedback to PlayerSettingsScreen.tsx. Uses triggerLight() for player option selections (SettingItem presses) and back button navigation. Uses triggerMedium() for all Switch toggles (Auto-play Best Stream, Always Resume, External Player for Downloads). Committed as c0d7804b.

subtasks.notes: Added haptic feedback to TraktSettingsScreen.tsx, TMDBSettingsScreen.tsx, MDBListSettingsScreen.tsx, and DebridIntegrationScreen.tsx. Implemented triggerLight() for navigation/selection, triggerMedium() for toggles/save buttons, and triggerHeavy() for destructive actions (disconnect, clear, remove).

subtasks.notes: Added haptic feedback to all 6 remaining settings screens: CatalogSettingsScreen.tsx, ContinueWatchingSettingsScreen.tsx, HomeScreenSettings.tsx, NotificationSettingsScreen.tsx, AISettingsScreen.tsx, and BackupScreen.tsx.
